extent_convention: Named bounds in degrees; each town has a 1-degree by 1-degree box centred on its coordinates.

forecast.daily_rainfall: Difference cumulative tp at consecutive 24-hour lead times, then multiply metres by 1000 to obtain mm.
forecast.date_selection: Select forecast initializations from start_date through end_date; restrict 24-hour valid intervals to the same period.
forecast.start_dates_note: Not yet agreed by the whole group. Part A checks forecast coordinates only; B/C/D must select and check finite forecast starts before use.

comparison.threshold_matching: Nearest CMORPH pixel for each forecast grid point within each town extent.
comparison.probability: Fraction of ensemble members whose 24-hour rainfall exceeds the local CMORPH threshold.
required_checks: Verify each extent lies within both dataset domains before nearest-point selection; coverage has not yet been checked.
Require finite forecast rainfall and CMORPH thresholds; mask missing thresholds in probability maps.
Use descending latitude slices for forecasts and ascending latitude slices for CMORPH.
Forecast grid spacing is 0.25 degrees and CMORPH is approximately 8 km; nearest-pixel matching is not area-conservative regridding.
comparison.interpretation: The threshold is fitted to annual maxima from 1998-2024, not observed June-August 2025 rainfall or a seasonal return level.

part_a.town_sampling: Nearest CMORPH pixel to each town centre; no averaging or maximum over town extents.
part_a.units_if_missing_reason: Workshop E4 treats stored return levels and annual maxima as rainfall depths in mm. Explicit conflicting metadata is rejected; any fallback is logged.
part_a.second_duration_policy: Require 48hr. If unavailable, inspect the reported durations and agree another duration before editing this list.
